# ADR 0004: Keep all filed values and select the latest on read

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Company financials GraphQL API

## Context

Companies restate figures; analysts need both the current and the original value.

## Decision

Store every (concept, period, filed date) value; queries pick the latest filed per period.

## Consequences

Correct and auditable. More rows.

## Alternatives considered

Overwrite on import.
